mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2% annualized over the past two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past two months, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized over 2 months
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a strong labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months, coupled with a GDP (GDPC1) growth rate below 2% annualized, signals a weakening supply side and slowing economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 1% and GDPC1 < 2% annualized in 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% and GDPC1 < 2% annualized.
